actual_tool_arguments.prompt:
Edit this actual S3-08 warm-style candidate to remove the unfinished-table impression. Keep its subject, its warm-white #F6F3EE background, graphite #242424 type, warm-gray #E8E3DC structure, restrained vermilion #CE4B32 accent, large readable Chinese sans-serif typography and landscape aspect ratio. Replace the six empty table cells and all table gridlines. Do not fill them with checkmarks, icons, fabricated values, fake code, hashes or repeated filler words. There should be NO blank table or matrix in the new composition.

Use an open three-column editorial comparison arrangement. LEFT about 34 percent: three equally weighted, left-aligned source names stacked with generous line spacing inside one quiet pale warm-gray grouping: 原验证程序, 同源重建, SDK 实际链接. No arrows between these names, no empty boxes beside them. A thin non-directional bracket immediately to the right spans all three names to show these are the comparison subjects, not combined program outputs.

MIDDLE about 29 percent: an unboxed heading 对照核查 with a restrained short vermilion underline. Beneath it, two large lines naming the shared criteria: 装载内容 and 调用与输入. The bracket from the source group is a visual grouping annotation beside this criteria region, NOT a converging bus, NOT three program-output arrows and NOT a file merge. Under the criteria, keep 调试节可不同 as a short readable side note, without a connector. No drawings of files, chips, folders, code pages, plugs, magnifiers or other icons.

RIGHT about 30 percent: the existing-evidence conclusion, 沿用既有夹具证据, split into two balanced lines. The ONLY arrow in the whole figure is a short rightward arrow from the criteria region toward this conclusion, labeled 一致时. It expresses that matching loaded execution content and call/input contracts permits reuse of the existing test-fixture evidence. It must not imply a new run, a new performance measurement, arbitrary application qualification, or whole-ELF byte identity. Actual SDK linkage remains explicit.

Exact visible labels, once each: 原验证程序; 同源重建; SDK 实际链接; 对照核查; 装载内容; 调用与输入; 调试节可不同; 一致时; 沿用既有夹具证据. No additional words, values, overall title, figure number or caption. Every label large and clearly legible at 160mm width, minimum about 42 pixels on a 1600px canvas; do not shrink the type. Flat solid fills, fine rules, comfortable gutters, no texture, shadows, gradients, decorative dots or 3D. Produce a finished, sparse and convincing comparison concept rather than an unfilled form.

review.acceptance_criterion: Resolve the identified readability/scope defect while preserving the authorized B-style concept, accurate evidence boundaries, readable large labels and no overall title.
review.evidence: Viewed the actual 1585×992 output. The six empty table cells and row grid are gone. Three program sources are a plain grouped list, with SDK actual linkage explicit. The middle names loaded content and call/input criteria; the only arrow is conditional 一致时 toward reuse of existing fixture evidence. The separate note allows differing debug sections. All nine labels are large, unclipped and unambiguous; no placeholder values, icons, PASS mark or new-run claim.
review.limitations: The diagram expresses comparison and the conditional scope of evidence reuse, not a full ELF-byte equality proof or a new application qualification. Exact source, loaded-image, entry/call/input identities and original fixture scope remain in the adjacent report/source index. Raster typography has no point-size metadata.

adjacent_details_required: 三方为原已验证程序、同源复制重建和SDK实际链接接入。对照装载执行内容及调用/输入，不要求调试节或完整ELF全字节相同。
沿用的是原测试夹具已有资格和记录；没有新增EMU/NEMU/全核运行、性能、面积、STA或功耗测量。
真实链接、装载/入口及调用输入身份、原16函数/48用例两轮96正常调用及8×32适用子集由相邻正文和原结果记录说明。
不同最终镜像、新包装或新实际应用的资格按原合同判断，图不作任意接入保证。
